verdict_summary: All 6 review issues (I1-I4, S1-S2) are properly addressed in the revised plan. I1: same pipeline for non-shock days explicitly stated in sample_non_shock_baseline and data_flow ('同一銘柄ユニバース、同一vol計算'). I2: min_gap=20 is a named parameter in the bootstrap function signature and enforced per review_fixes. I3: non-shock defined as complement of 2sigma shock set; old |S&P500|<1sigma restriction explicitly removed. I4: Spearman rank correlation with 95% CI at event-date level aggregation. S1: vol-low group computed alongside vol-high, pseudo-DiD is the primary pass criterion. S2: effect size with 95% CI reported. Plan is coherent and ready for implementation.
